I’VE NEVER USED AI FOR IMAGE GENERATION, UNTIL NOW... 🤯

I was ready to write this off, and then I saw what it did with one photo in 8 seconds.

In total transparency, I don’t use AI for image generation as I find Chat warps every image and Nano Banana is too slow for my impatient brain. 

So skeptically, I fed it a real photo of a model, a pair of sunglasses, jewellery and a top and prompted it to give me a range of creative assets that could be used on a CRM send.

It took 8 seconds to provide me with 11 images. My four favourites below.

 Krea has the quality of Nano Banana Pro, but 4x faster, is a quarter of the cost and your prompt builds don’t distort your last image (*cries with happiness*)

If you’re searching for a fast way to generate creative assets then try Krea 3: https://lnkd.in/eqd8dTyD 

Let me know what you think!
